༄༅/ /skyes rabs las brtsams pa'i gsol 'debs dri ma med pa padma'i phreng ba dad pa'i mdzes rgyan bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// skyes rabs las brtsams pa'i gsol 'debs dri ma med pa padma'i phreng ba dad pa'i mdzes rgyan bzhugs so//

sa gsum 'gro ba'i gnyen dang skyabs gcig pu// thub dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i bstan pa ni// bshad dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'dzin mdzad pa// bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'das dus thub mchog shākya'i rgyal po yi// chos 'dul mdzod 'dzin bram ze sgra mkhan rgyud kyi brtul zhugs spyod pa'i mtshan sa ra ha chen po gcan 'dzin// zag pa rnams zad dgra bcom 'bras bu brnyes// rig grol gnyis ldan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs| |slob dpon padmas bsil ba'i tshal du brtul zhugs mchog spyod tshe// gdol pa'i rigs kyis zab lam sbyor sgrol rnams// yongs 'dzin gsang sngags slob dpon padma'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa// 'jigs med seng ge'i zhabs la gsol 'debs// chu klung byang phyogs gaṅgā la nye bar gaṅgā'i ngogs su bram ze mchog /chags ldan bu yis gtsang sbra'i brtul zhugs mdzad// rang srog rlung nad kyis dus byas dor yang sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin| |khye'u dga' byed zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mi rtag tshe yi 'du byed yongs bzlog phyir// 'chi med lha yis byin brlabs rjes puṣpa ha rir bzung yang*| |dam tshig slob ma dam log pa'i dbang gis gzugs sku dbyings su thim// drang srong nyi ma mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'phags yul lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs su// utpal la dang mdzes ldan yab yum sras// rgyal khrims tshul gyis 'gro rnams bde la bkod// rgyal po dge khrims zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zangs gling srid skyong dpal skyes nang pa'i rgyal po'i rgyal po'i sras// mu stegs tshar bcad thub bstan spel mdzad pa'i// rlabs chen rgyal ba'i go 'phang don gnyer ba// rgyal po 'od mdzes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gdol rgya gar byang phyogs utpala'i tshal pa'i rigs las bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing*// rig gnas lnga lnga rig paṇa chen chos 'khor nā lend+ra'i 'phags yul// mkhan por mu stegs kyis kha zas dug can drangs pas tshe'i dus byas dbang bskur thub bstan bdag po mchog

/lha yi zla ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dmangs rigs las byung mun chen dur khrod du// brtul lo bdun nas lus ma bzhag par mkha' spyod du gshegs zhugs spyod pas nges don mngon du gyur// phyogs las rnam rgyal gsang sngags don mang rtogs// gtum srung rnal 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gnyan gyi lo tsā dar ma grags kyi drung*// zhal bzhi'i chos skyong bsnyen pas grub pa thob// gzhan gyi byad khas tshe'i 'du byed bsdus// rgyal po chos mdzad zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dal 'byor don yod rang byung lhan skyes rtogs// chos sku mngon gyur nges don smra ba'i mchog /lus dang bcas te mkha' spyod mngon du bsgrod// ngam shod sras me long rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgya gar lho phyogs bhaṅga la ru 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nyid// 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog gis rjes bzung zhing*// de yi sku brnyan bod yul ljongs jo bo bcu gcig zhal klung shod ra 'dzab nas gdan drangs pa da lta gtsang smad g.yas ru gzhu lu grong gi gsang sngags mchog grub gling gi rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs su bskur// rgyal po legs byin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal rigs rgya gar nub phyogs mchog las thub bstan sgor zhugs shing*// mkhas pa'i grags pas 'chad rtsod rtsom la brtson// bod yul ljongs su thub bstan dar bar mdzad// paṇa chen chos bod yul du 'das pa'i gdung da lta spras kyi sha ba 'bum pa na yod kyi yid der gsol ba 'debs/ rdo rje gdan dbus gyur tshal du bram ze'i rigs gyi byang phyogs 'dod ldan du// rgyal rigs thub bstan sgor zhugs rab tu byung*// phyir rgol tshar bcad thub bstan gsal bar mdzad// legs mthong bden smra'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// slar yang yul der cho rigs btsun pa'i sras// nges par 'byung zhing dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa// dngos su bran g.yog bka' nyan srung sdod pa// zhi ba'i mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgya gar lho phyogs ind+ra'i rgyal rigs che// sa bdag klu yi nad kyis gdungs pa'i tshe// drang srong dmod pas skad cig nyid la grol// dharmā sho ka'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje gdan gyi rgyal tshab seng ge'i khrir// mngon par dbang bskur lnga gnas rig paṇḍi tas// thub bstan rdzogs ldan dus la'ang 'gran mdzad pa// chos kyi phreng ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gtsang rong lha rje gnubs chung kyi slob ma'i mchog

/'khor lo gnyis kyi nan tan mchog bsgrubs pas// rang don mthar phyin de nyid mngon rtogs pa// tshul khrims mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// thub bstan sgor zhugs lung rigs thos pas phyug /jo bo jo bo rje a ti sha yi slob ma'i mchog /rje des bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur ba// khu ston g.yung drung zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mang yul phyogs las bstan la rab tu byung*// bsam gtan mchog sgom grub pa'i dngos grub thob| |rten 'brel dbang gis gzhan don brtson la bgyis// yon tan blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mdo khams rngod kyi ya ngan sribs phyogs su rig sngags 'chang ba'i dpal// 'jam dpal khro chus rjes bzung grub pa thob// log rtog dregs byed tshar gcod rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bal yul grub mchog ba su dha ra yis// rjes su bzung zhing mchog gi dngos grub thob// 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal mthong rjes su bzung*// hūm̐ chen ka ha ra kha bdud brtul ba po ra'i zhabs la gsol ba'adebs// bod yul ngam shod lha lam khyon chen por// khri srong lde'u 'od dkar las bskrun pas// rgyal khrims chos kyi khrims ldan mtha' bzhi btul// mu tig btsad po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal mgon tsa turmu kha'i rjes su bzung*// kha'u'i brag la yengs med sgom pa'i tshe// 'khor 'das ma lus rang sems gdeng thob ces// grags pa ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ngam shod phyogs kyi rig pa smra ba'i mchog /gtsug lag rtsis kyi rig gnas ji snyed rnams// ma lus lus med kun nas 'doms mdzad pa// dge bshes tshul khrims legs grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rta dbyangs ngam shod du slob dpon rta dbyangs dge bshes mchog gi dbang por gyur pa'i tshe mchog gi dbang por gyur pa'i tshe// slob ma'i khyu mchog dad pa'i dpal thob cing*// bla ma'i bka' sgrub ji bzhin dam srung ba| |grags pa mchog gi zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mdo khams rtse gdong phyogs su rab bltams shing*// ri bo shantir mnyam med 'tsho byed drung*// gdams pa mnos pas 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// sems don ngo bo gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// bde gshegs phag gru'i phrin las sku tshe'i stod thog ma'i tshe// gtsang rong phyogs kyi slob ma ro gcig rtogs// bla ma'i drin lan sgrub pa'i chos kyis gzhal// chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol 'debs// rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jig rten mgon po'i drung*// slob ma'i mchog gyur dam chos mdzod 'dzin cing*// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan spyan snga ba/

/shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs sbyar smra ba'i skad rigs mngon gyur cing*/ /ka tsan mdo dang de yi gzhung lugs sogs| |dam chos mang po'i bka' drin bod 'dir bsgyur/ /blo gros brtan pa'i gsum pa zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// legs sbyar gzhung lugs 'bum phrag du ma rnams// khyod thugs 'doms pas skad gnyis rab smra zhing*// gsung rab kun gyi yin min 'byed mkhas pa// rdo rje rgyal shong ston mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gnyis med rdzogs chen mchog mnga' klong chen gyi// rigs las byung ba'i padma dbang chen zhes// bka' rtags dbu gtsug rta gdong phyag rgyas spras// zla ba grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /la thog zur mkhar rgyal po'i pho brang du// gso rig yan lag brgyad sogs mngon gyur pas// 'gro kun zug rngu'i nad las sgrol mdzad pa// mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gser mdog can du thub dbang gnyis pa shākya mchog gi drung*// sras kyi thu bo thos pas legs phyug cing*// rgyal dbang de yi rgyal tshab chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa// don yod grub pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs| |byang chub mthil du gling log gi dus gling du dus kyi 'jig byung tshe// skyu ra'i rigs kyi bstan pa rab gling gi zhig gsos gsos shing*// dpal mgon beng gis grub pa'i dngos grub byin// rdo rje rin chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// skyu ra'i gdung las sgom gzhung 'dug par pa'i mtshan 'dzin cing*// gdung brgyud gser gyi phreng ba spel mkhas pas// sgrub brgyud phyogs mthar dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa// rin chen rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// padmas rjes bzung lung bstan gnang ba thob// gsang sngags mchog gi chos kun mngon gyur cing*// rig 'dzin rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog /sna tshogs rang grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'gru rgyal rigs kyi 'od dkar ma nyams shing*// tshogs gnyis bye ba'i cha rdzogs mngon mtho'i dpal// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos gdung rigs mchog

/bstan 'gror phan chung bar bsam bzhin nying mtshams sbyar der gsol ba 'debs// da lta'i rigs rus mngon mtho'i dpal thob cing*// dge slong thos ldan 'khor lo gnyis klog pa thos bsam nan tan kyis phyug /bslab gsum mdo rgyud rig gnas mdzod 'dzin pa// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ma 'ongs skyu ra'i gdung brgyud da lta nas rtsis pa'i tha ma ru// sbrul lo pa yis zab gter gter sgrom nas dgongs pa yang zab kyi 'phro 'byin zhing*// dam chos a ti yo gas 'gro kun sgrol// don grub chos kyi 'bangs der gsol ba 'debs da lta nas rtsis pa'i tshe tshad brgyad cu tsam yin par tshe mthar phyin na 'di la skye mi dgos kyang tshe tshad lnga bcu bas mang ba mi sdod pa'i rten 'brel mang zhing de'i sngon du 'chi yang srid pas da lta'i tshe lhag la 'dir yong dgos// stod lung phyogs su sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin| |tshe yi zab chos mang kha rag tshe chu phug nas po'i gter 'byin zhing*// 'gro kun 'chi med lam du 'god mdzad pa// bdud 'dul grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'phags yul byang gling mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta// gzhung lugs smra la snyengs pa yongs med cing*// mkhas mang dbus su grags pa'i dpal thob pa// nyi ma snying gi zhabs la gsol ba 'debs| |mngon dga'i zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba klong yangs drung*/ /chos mdzod kun 'dzin bka' yi bsdu ba po// chu la zegs ma nam mkhar sprin gyi tshul// bzhin bzang zla ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdun pa sangs rgyas rab gsal shākya shrī 'byon pa'i dus bskal bzang gi// byang chub sems dpa' dam chos mdzod 'dzin pas// dri ba dang lan gyis tshul du chos tshul gsal mdzad pa// byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa'i snang ba gang der gsol ba 'debs// mthar thug byang chub snying por bzhugs pa'i tshe// bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas dgu pa'i mtshan gyi 'od dkar can| |bskal bzang mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston mkhas pa// me tog mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gzhan yang rang rang snod ldan gdul bya'i phyir// zhing khams kun na thugs rje'i rnam rol gyis// sprul pa'i snang brnyan phyogs brgyar g.yo mkhas pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// rgyal ba mchog khyod mthar thug byang chub nas// bskal bzang dgu pa me tog nyid gyur te// dam chos 'khor lo rim gsum bskor ba'i tshe// bdag sogs 'khor gyi thog mar skyes nas kyang*// khyod kyi chos mdzod 'dzin dang sdud pa dang*// dar zhing rgyas dang khyod kyi rgyal tshab tu// dbang bskur chos kyi snang ba rab rgyas nas// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/ces chos mdzad tshul khrims rin chen gyis nan gyis dgos zer bar rang gi skye ba'i dran snang 'das pa so bdun dang*/ da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa lnga/ mthar byang chub snying por byed tshul rnams bsdoms pas bzhi bcu zhe bzhi'i gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang*| dge slong chos kyi grags pas chos 'khor byams pa gling gi chos grwa chen po'i gtsug lag khang gi yang thog tu mgyogs par bris pa'o/// /
